description: EMBOSS 6.6 stretcher: global alignment by the Myers-Miller linear-space algorithm (Myers & Miller 1988) with affine gaps and INTEGER scores; a gap of length k costs gapOpen + (k-1)*gapExtend (the EMBOSS convention), end gaps are charged like any gap, residues are upper-cased, a residue that is not in the matrix scores 0. The rows are the rows of the installed stretcher 6.6.0 (its midpoint tie rules differ from global_align_affine; the score is the same). VERIFICATION: rows and score identical on 689 / 689 committed random DNA / IUPAC / protein pairs (1-260 residues, gap penalties 0-20 / 0-6, 10 matrices). Input sequences are read as EMBOSS reads them (A4-3, one shared reader): only letters and '*' are kept; gap characters (- . ~ ?), '#', '+', '_', digits, blanks and every other character are dropped first, and positions, lengths and scores count the cleaned sequence (e.g. needle of AC-GTTAGC.TT* and ACGTTAGCTT: score 58, length 11, as the program).

matrix.description: EMBOSS data matrix (-datafile) or NCBI name; default EDNAFULL (nucleotide) / EBLOSUM62 (protein).

gapOpen.description: -gapopen (>= 0): cost of a gap of length 1; default 16 (nucleotide) / 12 (protein).

gapExtend.description: -gapextend (>= 0): cost of each further gap position; default 4 (nucleotide) / 2 (protein).

format.description: Optional output format; the alignment written in that format is returned in 'formatted'. Biopython Bio.Align names: fasta, a2m, clustal, phylip, nexus, stockholm (byte for byte as Bio.Align.write; 'emboss:' + name selects the EMBOSS writer of the same name) or EMBOSS -aformat names (pair, simple, srspair, srs, markx0-3, markx10, match, score, sam, tcoffee, msf, mega, meganon, nexusnon, paup, paupnon, phylipnon, selex, treecon). Omit for no formatted text.

names.description: Optional names of the rows for the formatted output (default seq1, seq2, ...).

exactScore.description: The score as a real number.

formatted.description: The alignment written in the requested format (null when format is omitted).

errors.message: unknown matrix; gapOpen or gapExtend negative
